events.quote: we decided to remove this from Glamsterdam. This is not a spec change, because this specifies behavior, but… Can impact this never happen? And after many debates, we settled that we don't want to do this
events.note: Jochem confirmed it is cancelled, not postponed, superseded by EIP-8253 targeting Hegota. Formal sign-off confirmed by Parithosh at 0:32:04 with no objections.

events.quote: we have EIP8253 for PFI via Hegota, and this directly solves this problem, because this ensures that no accounts of the type which EIP7610 targets are into the state tree
events.note: Jochem stated EIP-8253 is PFI for Hegota as rationale for removing EIP-7610 from Glamsterdam.

events.quote: The proposal is to do, the fork on 28th of September, so basically over a month from now.
events.note: Parithosh stated no decision needed today; to be confirmed at next ACDC in two weeks. No objections raised on the call. Dima (Lido) asked via chat for dates to be shifted a week later.

events.quote: the proposal was to then have Hoodi, end of October, so that would still give us plenty of time to see how Sepolia pans out
events.note: Explicitly stated as contingent on stable DevNets and Sepolia outcome. No formal decision made on this call.
